description: Presidential Secretariat - Resignation of a Minister a non Cabinet Minister and a State Minister w.e.f. 11.01.2019
categorisation: The gazette content exclusively announces the resignations of three named individuals (Hon. Daya Gamage, Hon. Harsha de Silva, and Hon. Ranjith Aluvihare) from their government positions (Minister of Labour, Trade Union Relations and Social Empowerment; Non Cabinet Minister of Public Distribution and Economic Affairs; and State Minister of Tourism Development, respectively). It provides only the individuals' names and their basic titles, with no detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities or any structural/administrative changes to the government itself. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
